liebermann.description_de: Verlorene Vorlage von hrl, Ps Cn for und dhu für In Cn
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of hrl, Ps Cn for and dhu, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.notes: A common source for In Cn of hrl, of Ps Cn for and of dhu, posited by Liebermann.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): O’Brien’s family tree has no such shared source of H and Di: H (γ), Di with the Huntingdon copies (β) and T with Cb (δ) each come separately from the original (α).
